text.p: The possible defection of Iain Napier, chief executive of Bass Plc 's Bass Brewers, to join British leisure company Rank Group Plc is "highly unlikely", industry sources said on Thursday.
The sources dismissed as "not credible" reports in the Guardian newspaper on Thursday that Napier would become head of Rank's leisure division.
They said Napier had only recently assumed his position at the brewing division from the leisure division at Bass and was also recently appointed to Bass' main board.
Napier is overseeing Bass' planned takeover of rival brewer Carlsberg-Tetley. The British government is expected to rule on the takeover in the next few days.
Bass is seeking to buy Carlsberg's 50 percent of Carlsberg-Tetley. If approved, Danish brewer Carlsberg would keep a 20 percent share in a merged Carlsberg-Tetley-Bass.
Fears that Britain may veto the deal has put pressure on Bass and Carlsberg shares.
